agent: converter convert.py (Sonnet 5.5), from the repository file RESULTS.json (salvo g4) and the paper PDF text

extractions.tool: text extraction of the PDF by salvo g4 (page by page); quotes are matched after NFKC and whitespace normalisation

convert.py (this folder): one row per system (model, effort) of RESULTS.json; correct_of_total = the sum of `correct` over the system's 18 task x difficulty records / the sum of `total` (4800 questions), parse_failures and truncations = sums of the data file's fields. A derived cell: the data file holds the per-task counts only
